Privacy policy

Last updated November 22, 2026 · Contact: support@tennisimo.app

The short version

  • Your videos are used only to analyse your tennis.
  • Match and rally videos are deleted right after they are analysed.
  • The AI coach is sent numbers only, never your video.
  • We do not sell your data and there are no ads.
  • You can delete your account and everything in it from the app at any time.

What we collect

  • Account: your email address and a password (stored hashed by our sign-in provider). We never see your password.
  • Videos you choose to upload: single-swing clips, and match or rally videos.
  • Results we compute from them: pose-based swing measurements, scores, ball speed (when you calibrate), shot maps, rally counts and coaching text.
  • Usage: the time you last opened the app and the platform (web, Android or iOS). Nothing else is tracked, and there are no advertising or analytics SDKs.

What we do not collect

We do not use face recognition or build any biometric template. Body keypoints are computed in memory to measure the swing and are not stored. We do not access your contacts, location or microphone. The camera is used only while you are recording a clip.

How we use it

Only to provide the app: measuring your swing, showing your progress over time, and writing coaching tips. We do not sell, rent or share your data for advertising.

The AI coach

Coaching text is written by Google Gemini from the numbers our own code computed (for example "elbow angle 148°"). Gemini is never sent your video, images, body keypoints, email or account id.

Who processes your data

  • Supabase: sign-in, database and video storage.
  • Google Cloud Run: the server that analyses your videos.
  • Google Gemini API: turns computed numbers into coaching text.

Each processes data only to run this service for us.

How long we keep it

  • Match and rally videos: deleted as soon as they are analysed. One still picture of the court is kept so you can check the lines we used.
  • Swing clips, results and your account: kept until you delete them or your account.
  • Deleting a match or rally removes its results immediately.

Your rights and choices

You can delete any match or rally from its screen, and delete your whole account from Profile › Delete account. Account deletion permanently removes every video, every result and your login, and cannot be undone. To ask for a copy of your data or for any other privacy request, email support@tennisimo.app.

Children

Tennisimo is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from them. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.

Security

All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Videos are stored in a private folder only your account can reach, and every request is checked against your signed-in session.

Changes

If this policy changes we will update the date below and, for significant changes, tell you in the app.
